name: us-sales-tax-2026
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed 2026 US tax reference: us-sales-tax-2026.json/csv (state + local combined sales tax rates), us-lodging-taxes-2026.csv (state-level TOT/occupancy/tourism-assessment rates only, no city breakdown, no revenue/collections time series), STATES_TABLE.md summary, plus a free REST API and embeddable calculator. Reviewed 17 Jun 2026, annual-update cadence.
why_useful: Could be a reference table for state-level lodging tax rate levels (Nevada/Florida/Texas/California/NY/Hawaii rates) but has no historical collections series or occupancy figures, so it doesn't fill the gap #8 need for actual occupancy/RevPAR/tax-collection time series.
themes: State and city hotel occupancy and lodging-tax datasets (Nevada, Florida tourist development tax, Texas hotel occupancy tax, California TOT, NYC hotel occupancy tax, Hawaii TAT)
why_all: Could be a reference table for state-level lodging tax rate levels (Nevada/Florida/Texas/California/NY/Hawaii rates) but has no historical collections series or occupancy figures, so it doesn't fill the gap #8 need for actual occupancy/RevPAR/tax-collection time series.

Gives current statutory lodging-tax rates by state (including NV, FL, TX, CA, HI) as a reference/cross-check, but explicitly contains no collections or occupancy volume history, so it does not address the tax-collections-as-demand-proxy angle the theme is really after.

name: 2025-Bexar-County-Proposition-B-Results-by-Precinct
what_it_holds: Interactive precinct-level map/dataset of the 2025 Bexar County (San Antonio, TX) Proposition B vote — a referendum on county funding for a new stadium tied to a hotel-occupancy-tax increase. Election results by precinct, not tax collections figures.
why_useful: Documents a concrete Texas hotel-occupancy-tax policy event (rate increase tied to stadium financing) that a regulatory-event tracker could log, but the payload is voting geography, not lodging-tax revenue or occupancy data.
themes: State and city hotel occupancy and lodging-tax datasets (Nevada, Florida tourist development tax, Texas hotel occupancy tax, California TOT, NYC hotel occupancy tax, Hawaii TAT)
Tourist tax and city-tax datasets: Paris taxe de sejour, Amsterdam toeristenbelasting, Italian imposta di soggiorno, Airbnb remittance reports, occupancy-tax remittance by platform
why_all: Documents a concrete Texas hotel-occupancy-tax policy event (rate increase tied to stadium financing) that a regulatory-event tracker could log, but the payload is voting geography, not lodging-tax revenue or occupancy data.
Only tangentially related: shows local political appetite for raising hotel/occupancy taxes in one US county, not a national or ABNB-relevant collections series. Flagging for completeness only.

name: japan-stay-tax
what_it_holds: Zero-dependency TypeScript/JS library computing Japan's municipal accommodation tax (宿泊税) rate schedules for Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Niseko and 20+ other municipalities. Rate tables only, no collections/occupancy time series. Last updated 24 Aug 2026 (a near-duplicate fork/rewrite exists at Capricious-storage478/japan-stay-tax, updated 12 Sep 2026).
why_useful: Tangential to the theme's US-state focus, but a real, current lodging-tax rate-schedule dataset for a major APAC tourism market (gap #7 regional travel volume outside US/EU is APAC-focused); rates only, no demand signal.
themes: State and city hotel occupancy and lodging-tax datasets (Nevada, Florida tourist development tax, Texas hotel occupancy tax, California TOT, NYC hotel occupancy tax, Hawaii TAT)
APAC STR datasets: Tokyo/Kyoto minpaku registration data, Seoul, Bangkok, Bali, Sydney/Melbourne, Auckland, Singapore, Hong Kong Airbnb data and regulation
why_all: Tangential to the theme's US-state focus, but a real, current lodging-tax rate-schedule dataset for a major APAC tourism market (gap #7 regional travel volume outside US/EU is APAC-focused); rates only, no demand signal.

A structured, versioned dataset of Japanese municipal lodging-tax rates and changes (a regulatory-cost input on STR/hotel unit economics in Japan, and a changelog that is quasi-point-in-time for rate changes) rather than free text.

name: smitkiri/schengen-visa
what_it_holds: Committed Schengen visa statistics by consulate: 2017-consulates-schengen-visa-stats.xlsx (638KB) and 2017-data-for-consulates.csv (156KB), plus 2018 xlsx. Consulate-level visa application/issuance/refusal counts sourced from the EU Schengen visa statistics releases. Only 2017-2018 vintages present; 0 stars, last updated 2020, no explicit license.
why_useful: Schengen visa issuance by consulate/nationality is a proxy for EU-bound inbound long-haul travel demand (EMEA region mix, gap area not directly listed but adjacent to gap #7/#10 travel volume series); dataset is old (2017-18) so mainly useful as a template for pulling the current EU Schengen visa statistics release (published annually by the European Commission) rather than as current data.
themes: Cross-border and visa data: Schengen visa statistics, ESTA, ETIAS, CBP wait times, passport index, border crossings BTS
why_all: Schengen visa issuance by consulate/nationality is a proxy for EU-bound inbound long-haul travel demand (EMEA region mix, gap area not directly listed but adjacent to gap #7/#10 travel volume series); dataset is old (2017-18) so mainly useful as a template for pulling the current EU Schengen visa statistics release (published annually by the European Commission) rather than as current data.
